findings.title: Bulk sensitive data exposure
findings.description: An endpoint returns a list of records with personal or financial fields, and it is either reachable without a token or not documented, so nobody reviewed what it hands out.
findings.detail: GET /customers (customer-management-backend) returns a list with pii fields
factors: likelihood -1: reachable only inside the cluster
findings.owasp: API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization
findings.recommendation: Reduce fields and require an admin role on /customers.
mitigation: Return only the fields the client needs (response schema / DTO, not the raw record).
Paginate with a hard maximum and require an admin role for bulk export.
Log every bulk export with the caller identity.

findings.title: Sensitive operation answers anonymous callers
findings.description: Requests with no credential at all got a 2xx response from an endpoint that returns sensitive data or changes state.
findings.detail: DELETE /policies/{policyId} (policy-management-backend) returned 2xx to 15 request(s) without a token
factors: likelihood -1: reachable only inside the cluster
findings.recommendation: Add authentication to DELETE /policies/{policyId} in policy-management-backend.
mitigation: Require a verified token on this operation in the service itself, not only at the gateway.
Reject requests without Authorization with 401 before any business logic runs.
Add a test that calls the endpoint anonymously and expects 401.

findings.title: Possible broken object level authorization (BOLA)
findings.description: An authenticated endpoint takes an object ID from the path and returns or changes that object. No 403 was ever observed, so there is no sign that ownership is checked.
findings.detail: GET /customers/{customerId} (customer-self-service-backend): object ID from path, response carries owner field customerId, 0 x 403 in 40 calls
factors: likelihood -1: reachable only inside the cluster
findings.recommendation: Add an ownership check to GET /customers/{customerId} in customer-self-service-backend.
mitigation: Check that the object belongs to the caller (or that the caller's role allows it) on every access.
Return 404 for objects the caller does not own, so IDs cannot be enumerated.
Prefer random IDs (UUIDs) over sequential integers.

findings.title: Login has no visible brute-force protection
findings.description: The login endpoint returned failures but never a 429 or lockout, and no rate-limiting directive in the gateway or Ingress configuration covers it, so password guessing is not being slowed down.
factors: likelihood -1: reachable only inside the cluster
evidence: no rate-limiting directive on its gateway route or Ingress
findings.recommendation: Add rate limiting and lockout to /auth.
mitigation: Rate-limit login per account and per IP (e.g. 5 failures / 15 min) and return 429.
Add MFA for privileged accounts and alert on failure spikes.

findings.title: Shadow endpoint (running, not documented)
findings.description: The endpoint receives traffic but is in no API specification, so it was never part of a design review.
findings.detail: GET /applications (spring-boot-admin) is served but in no spec
factors: likelihood -1: reachable only inside the cluster
findings.recommendation: Document or remove GET /applications in spring-boot-admin.
mitigation: Either document the endpoint (and review it) or remove it.
Fail CI when a service serves routes missing from its spec (compare traffic with spec).
